item.title: Introducing Stream Sync Engage: Real-Time Engagement, Smarter Delivery
item.description: At Mach Five Tech, we believe that apps should respond to users in the moment. That is the core promise behind our new product Stream Sync Engage (SSE) — a live notification engine built for modern apps that want to go beyond static push. Stream Sync Engage architecture: Real-time event delivery with intelligent targeting, offline recovery, and multi-platform support. Why Stream Sync Engage Matters Applications today demand more than just alerts.
